derivation: a particle probably akin to G427 (ἄνευ);
def: aloof, i.e. apart from (literally or figuratively)

occurrences.text: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
